findings.question: Digital identity credentials (The national eID scheme's accounts, credentials and assurance levels): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: valtion hallintoviranomaisten ja virastojen, laitosten ja liikelaitosten sekä kunnallisten viranomaisten tulee tarjota lakisääteisiin palveluihin liittyvä tunnistautuminen Suomi.fi-tunnistus -palvelulla.
findings.quote_english: state administrative authorities and agencies, institutions and enterprises, and municipal authorities must provide identification for statutory services with the Suomi.fi-tunnistus service.
findings.title: Tunnistus
findings.note: Suomi.fi-tunnistus is the common public-administration identification broker (credentials: bank IDs, mobile certificates, DVV certificate cards); the reviewer may prefer it over the earlier 'Varmennetietojärjestelmä', but it is a broker rather than a credential register.

review.reason: The quote on dvv.fi names Suomi.fi-tunnistus as the service public authorities must use to authenticate users for statutory services; it names the identification system but not the individual credential register.

findings.quote_english: ERICA is a nationwide emergency response centre information system shared by the actors participating in emergency centre operations, enabling a uniform 112 service and networked operation everywhere in Finland.
findings.value: Hätäkeskustietojärjestelmä ERICA (ERICA emergency response centre information system)

review.reason: The quote names ERICA as the national emergency centre information system shared by the agencies that take part in emergency centre operations, which supports a uniform 112 service across Finland.
